name: Setouchi (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Setouchi town emblem in maroon: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Setouchi, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in December 1957.

features.role: Setouchi town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes
